abilities.description: After assigning all your starting stats, add +1 to Edge.

Great resolve: Once per session, whenever something terrible happens that shakes your faith in yourself or your capabilities, and you have a moment to look both inward and outward, meditating as your people have taught you, you may @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.a2d7793b23c17489]{Secure an Advantage} and automatically take a strong hit. Also once per session, you may downgrade one @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.ff32c523829d6481]{Endure Stress} move, to a minimum of -1.
